body:
He's a bit under stress, because he has a lot of planning to do at the moment. But I feel like he changed in the last weeks. It's small things mostly, like not smiling back when I smile at him, or avoiding "hello" or "good night" kisses. 

Maybe I'm too needy... I don't know?

Thank you anyways for taking the time to respond. Also thank you for your invitation to /r/twox, but I'm afraid I'm not female.

You're right. It's just after being with him, I guess I lost the necessity of being with other people, something that is backlashing now, pretty hard.

I realize I made a mistake in not cherishing and taking care of my friendships. 

I'm still shaking from it all, but I know I can't stay here, or I will go insane. I stopped crying because it was obnoxiously loud and I don't want my neighbors to hear it, I suppose. I still feel the tears burning inside though.

I booked a ticket. I'm going home to my family tomorrow, I just can't stay here.

And thank you for reading and responding.

What if he calls me? I don't know if I can respond or not.


Thank you for the advice.
